title: PhysioAppKit 0.1.0
text: First public release. Domain-neutral single-case engine physiological application layers. nap() / interpret_nap(): Nonoverlap Pairs effect size + bands. nonoverlap_analyze(): single-case -vs-B analysis (NAP, threshold verdict, decision band), shared math behind MCID / SWC / SESOI layers. combine_verdicts(): honest supported / partial / refuted per-item flags. phase_plot(): generic single-case phase plot. rasch_measure() / raw_score_measure(): dependency-free dichotomous Rasch (JMLE) turning ordinal ratings interval (logit) scale. rbind_fill(), first_last(): container utilities.
